senses.gloss: wheat or other cultivated cereal crop used as food

senses.gloss: a single small hard seed of a cereal plant
senses.example: He fed the chickens a handful of grain in the morning.

translations.th_TH: เมล็ดธัญพืช; เมล็ดข้าว

example_translations.zh_TW: 他早上餵了雞一把穀粒。

senses.gloss: the texture or pattern of fibers in wood, stone, or paper
senses.example: To get a smooth finish, always sand the wood in the direction of the grain.

example_translations.ko_KR: 매끄럽게 마감하려면 항상 나뭇결 방향으로 목재를 사포질하세요.
